# PARA Social Automation

> Owner-scoped LinkedIn and Reddit research with persisted draft review and separately approved extension publishing.

## Required read order

1. [PARA integration guide](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.app/agent.md)
2. [Live OpenAPI 3.1](https://para-linkedin-api.onrender.com/openapi.json)

The integration guide contains the complete operating model, authentication
surfaces, use cases, research lifecycle, automatic human-review intake, explicit
publishing confirmation, queue states, and completion rules. OpenAPI is
authoritative for exact request and response schemas. Do not crawl the rest of
the site unless resolving a legacy link.

## Resource and identifier model

`User -> Workspace -> Project -> Platform registration -> Run -> Batch/draft`

- A workspace is the team and role boundary.
- A project is one cross-platform business initiative and the master runtime
  scope for connections, review, profiles, and publishing queues.
- A registration is one platform-specific discovery configuration containing
  topics, searches, sources, cadence, matching, webhook, and generation rules.
- A project currently has at most one LinkedIn registration and one Reddit
  registration; X uses one project-owned configuration.
- A connection assignment selects the extension account for one project,
  platform, and purpose. `DISCOVERY` and `POSTING` are separate.
- `project_id` selects the parent project, a returned registration ID addresses
  PARA's platform configuration, and caller-owned `external_id` reconciles it.
  These identifiers are not interchangeable.
- Registration creation without `project_id` creates an implicit personal
  compatibility project. New multi-project integrations must resolve and send
  the intended project ID.
- An explicit project can activate only after an included registration and its
  required discovery assignment are active. Pausing a project stops all of its
  platform work; pausing a registration stops only that platform.

## Authentication routing

- Dashboard login uses email and password at
  `POST https://para-linkedin-scraper.onrender.com/api/auth/login`. Its returned
  access token is valid only for dashboard `/api/*` workspace, project, review,
  and publishing operations. Use the refresh token only at `/api/auth/refresh`.
- If `user.mustChangePassword` is true, complete
  `/api/auth/change-password` before other dashboard operations. Password
  recovery starts at `/api/auth/forgot-password`.
- The initial owner-scoped public API key is supplied in the integration
  handoff. Read it from `PARA_API_KEY` and send it as `Authorization: Bearer` only
  to `https://para-linkedin-api.onrender.com/v1/*`.
- A public API key selects the owner and scopes, not a project. It cannot be
  exchanged for a dashboard token or used on publishing or extension endpoints.
- A key with `keys:manage` may use `/v1/api-keys`; creation and rotation return
  plaintext once. Never print, persist in a transcript, or place credentials in
  URLs, request bodies, logs, checkpoints, browser storage, or final reports.

## Agent directives

- Read the API key only from `PARA_API_KEY`; never print or persist it.
- Never invent resource IDs, business inputs, webhook URLs, subreddits, target
  users, or approvals.
- Resolve the workspace and project before mutating a registration or queue.
- Preserve an explicitly supplied `project_id`; do not silently trigger the
  implicit-project fallback.
- Reconcile registrations by exact `external_id`.
- Topics-only legacy creation is side-effect free.
- LinkedIn `use_case` creation may auto-activate exactly ten real-extension searches
  after successful compilation and webhook validation.
- Inspect `/plan`, require ten unique searches, and wait for terminal cycle
  state before claiming completion.
- LinkedIn author enrichment is first-pass-only; unavailable evidence is
  neutral `UNKNOWN`.
- Reddit author context is extension-only; never call Parallel for Reddit.
- Verify webhook HMACs against the raw body and deduplicate by
  `X-Webhook-Id`.
- Require explicit operator approval for archive, secret rotation, delivery
  replay, and API-key lifecycle.
- Ready generated drafts are persisted and automatically surfaced in the human
  review queue; generation alone never performs a platform action.
- An explicit dashboard confirmation creates a durable publishing queue item.
  The paired extension may execute only that approved snapshot later.
- The public API key cannot call dashboard publishing or extension device
  endpoints. With public API access alone, stop at review-ready.
